title: An Old-Fashioned Guardian
overview: 20 years after it's win over the Aposdoll invaders, the giant robot, Dandivine, seems like a fading memory...

title: An Ace, but Only Because of His Face
overview: As he worries about his relationship, Gekiha finds himself in Dandivine's cockpit with the Aposdolls' return.

title: Outcome of a Confession
overview: Gekiha is officially Dandivine's new pilot, but will his new duties allow him to attend to his love life?

title: The Golden Transfer Student
overview: A new transfer student named Suruga arrives at Gekiha's school and makes a huge impact.

title: With Friends Like These...
overview: Gekiha and Suruga each ponder the identity of their rival robot's pilot, blind to the truth.

title: Ballad of the Slippers
overview: Gekiha is injured and bedridden, leaving Dandivine without a pilot.

title: What Defines a Protagonist
overview: Gekiha has lost both Akane and Dandivine to Suruga. But will he give them up without a fight?
